Name: Breakable Custom Loot
Author: po0pfart
Description:
A famework that defines custom loot tables using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] for breakable objects such as:

[list]
[*]Geode
[*]Frozen geode
[*]Magma geode
[*]Omni geode
[*]Artifact trove
[*]Golden coconut
[*]Mystery box
[*]Golden mystery box
[/list]
This mod does nothing on its own. See [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40001?tab=docs]README[/url] on how to make mod using this framework.

Example mod:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40063]All Artifacts In Geode[/url]

Now you can make your own custom loot table for any breakables. Finish the museum collection faster, stocks up seeds, get your favourite furniture or clothing, whatever you can think of!

Check out my QoL mods on
[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/po0pfart/mods]po0pfart's Mods[/url]
